outcome_rules.completed: Retain all four exact commands, environment hashes/versions, input/output hashes, stdout, stderr, exit codes and comparison with archived outputs. Exit zero does not cure raw gate=false or sequencing no-go.

outcome_rules.unavailable_or_timeout: Record per-package not_attempted/unavailable/timeout and a failed or inconclusive joint with exact missing route/dependency/resource; no holds/PASS based solely on source reading. No automatic repair or retry.
